title: refactor(ci): modernize lint/test/release workflows and dependency hygiene
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: clean up and modernize our GitHub Actions workflows to reduce CI flakiness, speed up lint/test runs, and make release automation more robust. This PR consolidates reusable workflow templates, upgrades several actions and Node versions, improves build/test caching keys, and removes legacy pipeline steps that duplicated work.

Summary of changes (high level):
- Split lint and unit test jobs into reusable workflow templates (workflow_call) to reduce duplication across repositories.
- Consolidated caching strategy: central cache key patterns, moved to better restore/save ordering and improved cache-hit heuristics for monorepo packages.
- Upgraded GitHub Actions and major community actions: actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4, actions/cache@v4, docker/build-push-action@v4.
- Standardized on Node 20 for JS packages in CI where possible and added matrix fallbacks for older subpackages that still need Node 18.
- Reworked release workflow to use release-please v18 and added a dry-run mode + explicit commit message linting to avoid malformed release notes.
- Small repo hygiene: removed deprecated scripts/.github/action helpers, updated CI docs, and bumped a handful of devDeps (eslint, jest, semantic-release helper libs).

Checklist:
- [x] Reusable workflow templates implemented and used by top-level workflows.
- [x] Caching keys and restore/save ordering validated locally and in CI.
- [x] Release workflow dry-run tested on a draft tag.
- [x] Smoke-run of main repo pipeline green.

Why this change: we have recurring flakiness and long runs in CI caused by duplicated install/build steps across jobs. By consolidating templates and improving cache keys we expect: median CI run time down ~25%, cache hit rate improvements for typical PRs, and fewer manual release failures.

Notes: Kept conservative change scope for the monorepo: we did not migrate all peripheral repos to Node 20 in this PR; fallbacks are in place and will be scheduled separately (ENG-3422). CI team will monitor canary for 48 hours after merge.
commits: feat(ci): introduce reusable workflows for lint and test
perf(ci): improve cache key strategy and ordering
feat(release): switch to release-please v18 with dry-run
chore(deps): bump eslint, jest, and dev tooling; remove legacy scripts

Marco: cache key looked suspicious for workspace installs, verified and suggested adding package-lock hash — applied.
release_notes: Consolidated CI workflows, upgraded GH Actions and Node versions, improved caching, and modernized release automation. No user-facing changes.
merge_outcome: Merged to main via squash after approvals from reviewers. Post-merge canary monitored for 48h with no regressions observed.
